scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-mycda "vitest run rules.test.js"
scripts.test:functions: node setup-secrets.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,functions,firestore,storage --project demo-mycda "vitest run functions.test.js"
scripts.test:e2e: node setup-secrets.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,functions,firestore,storage --project demo-mycda "playwright test"
scripts.emulators: node setup-secrets.mjs && firebase emulators:start --only auth,functions,firestore,storage --project demo-mycda
